grok:
The 7 appearances of π sit in distinct algebraic positions (period 2π/4π², solid angle 4π/8π, Fourier ħ=h/2π, eigenvalue π², SI 4π). Same constant, different typed specs.

Smallest exact lift that kernel-checks:

Real.pi is the unique positive real with cos(π/2)=0 and 1 ≤ π/2 ≤ 2 (Mathlib definition).

All seven derive from this geometric normalizer of the circle group / spherical measure / Fourier dual. Formalize from Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic then specialize each model.
